title: Grateful Dead Live at Hill Auditorium on 1971-12-14
source: Source Info: Betty's 7" 2-track Master Soundboard Reels > PCM > PCM (14 bit)(Sony L-750ESX-HFB tape); Transfer Info: PCM (Sony SL-10)> Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 (wav 16-bit/44.1k)> Adobe Audition 3.0 > TLH flac16

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy Dec 14 1971 Ann Arbor show, highlighted by a symphonic "The Other One" → "Wharf Rat" and Ron “Pig” McKernan’s fresh keyboard textures.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers crystal‑clear soundboard quality that lets the band’s fire shine through, especially on the epic segue from The Other One into Wharf Rat. Reviewers rave about the tight playing, Pig’s added complexity on keys, and an overall vibe that feels both symphonic and incendiary. With no reported technical flaws, this set is a must‑hear for Deadheads.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviewers gave 4–5 stars and praised both the performance (standout jams, high energy) and the recording quality; thus a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific complaints; reviewers describe it as worth the price of admission and imply a clean, well‑mixed capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth flow with a memorable second‑half sequence; the "Other One" > "Wharf Rat" segue is highlighted as symphonic and powerful.

band_member_comments.Keys: Ron 'Pig' McKernan adds new complexity to the sound and is praised for being in fine form.
